name: Takahagi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Takahagi city emblem in navy: a disc with a pointed top enclosing a white keyhole-shaped device.
history: Municipal flag of Takahagi, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 19 February 1955.

features.role: Takahagi city emblem — a disc with a pointed top enclosing a white keyhole-shaped device
